Indian Navy Agniveer Apprentices INET Online Form 2026 – Extend – Full Details

Join Indian Navy has recently Invited application for the Agniveer Apprentice 01/2027 & 02/2027 Batch. Any candidate who is interested to fill this form, they should check eligibility, age limit & must read the Full Notification Before applying for the Indian Navy Agniveer Apprentices INET Online Form 2026 Recruitment. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 June 2026
  • Last Date : 05 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 July 2026
  • Correction Date : 06 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 550/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 550/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
